note: Frozen before Codex annotates test-3 and before any system runs on it. Committed and pushed first; totals are published whatever they are. Per-record outputs are never read.
question: On unread 'place, offset' labels, does selection-2 hold back mostly wrong regions, raising the share of ready regions that are correct without a large loss of useful coverage?

systems.without_check: hybrid-1 (rules-6 first, llm-x2g2-qwen3.5-4b-q4km where the rules reach no candidate), reviewed + derived extents

inputs.draw: benchmark draw-extra --name test-3 --seed benchmark-3/1 --size 120 --prefix P --shape place_offset --shape-version 2 --repeats 0 (EXTRA_VERSION 1)

annotations.annotator: Codex, calibrated against the owner on 60 validation records (record category 54/60, acceptable GNIS IDs 55/60; eval/reports/codex-calibration.md)
annotations.procedure: Codex fills eval/benchmark/test-3/worksheet.csv from eval/annotation_guide.md and the pinned GNIS snapshot, without opening other annotations, reports or system outputs. The owner's first commit of the worksheet after this declaration counts; it must pass the checker with 0 errors, and fixes go in a recorded further commit before any run.
annotations.label_for_results: Codex-annotated; agreement with the owner 54/60 (category), 55/60 (GNIS IDs). Secondary evidence.

how_it_runs: Outputs go to the locked folder eval/benchmark/test-3/reports/. Standard output goes to log files there.
Common options: --sample eval/benchmark/test-3/test-3.json --extents data/reviewed/extents.csv --derived-extents data/extents/derived.csv --out eval/benchmark/test-3/reports.

Without the check: `audit rules`; `audit llm --no-cache`; `audit hybrid --with-derived`; `audit score --worksheet eval/benchmark/test-3/worksheet.csv --with-derived --hybrid <out>/test-3-hybrid-1-extents-derived.json`.
With the check: the same with --selection-2 on rules and llm, and --with-derived --with-selection-2 on hybrid and score (hybrid report test-3-hybrid-1-extents-derived-sel2.json).

decision_rule.works: Among the regions selection-2 holds back, wrong ones are at least twice the correct ones, AND the share of ready regions that are correct rises by at least 5 percentage points.
decision_rule.computed_from: the two hybrid score reports' totals: held back correct = correct ready regions without the check minus with it; held back wrong = wrong ready regions without minus with

expectation_stated_in_advance: On read data selection-2 held back 5 correct and 20 wrong regions and raised precision by 7 (owner-annotated) and 16 (Claude-annotated) points. selection-1 looked similar on read data and failed on unread labels, so either outcome is plausible; the targeted sample should hold more regions than test-2 did.
secondary_reported: ready regions, correct, useful coverage for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, with and without the check
correct proposal candidates for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, and the hybrid minus rules difference (descriptive: Codex-annotated)
caveats: Codex is calibrated against the owner, not the owner; blindness cannot be verified.
selection-2, the derived extents and the systems were written by Claude, on dev data.
test-3 holds only one label shape (place, offset), chosen because it is where wrong references concentrate.
run_rules: Each run happens once. A technical failure may be rerun under this declaration and is recorded.
Only totals are published, in eval/reports/test-3.{md,json}.
